site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Funa Obuyambi Obwesigika Obw'omu Kitundu Okumpi Naawe
site.metaDescription: Teekawo ekiseera n'abayambi ab'omu kitundu abeesigika mu kuyonja, okuddaabiriza, okwewunda, okukuuma omuddo, okusengula, okulabirira ebisolo, okulabirira abakadde, okuyigiriza n'ebirala.
site.hero.body: Teekawo ekiseera n'abayambi mu kuyonja, okuddaabiriza, okwewunda, okukuuma omuddo, okusengula, okulabirira ebisolo n'ebirala okuva mu katale akamu ak'omu kitundu.
site.hero.review: Nnateekawo ekiseera n'omukozi w'emirimu emitonotono ku luguudo lwaffe mu ddakiika 10.
site.how.title: Obuyambi bwa kunyiga emirundi esatu
site.how.body: Okuva ku "neetaaga kino kikolebwe" okutuuka ku "kiteekeddwawo", nga tolina kukubagana ssimu, kuteebereza oba ebbeeyi ezitategeerekeka.
site.steps.0.1: Laba abayambi ab'omu kitundu abeesigika ku maapu ey'omu kiseera, nga bateekeddwa ng'ebanga n'emmunyeenye.
site.steps.1.1: Laba profayiro, empeereza n'ebbeeyi ennambulukufu nga tonnasalawo.
site.steps.2.1: Weereza obubaka, funa ebbeeyi era oteekewo ekiseera mu app. Okusasula omulimu kukkaanyizibwako butereevu n'omuyambi.
site.helpers.title: Kyusa obukugu bwo okufuna ensimbi mu kitundu
site.helpers.body: Teekateeka omulundi gumu otandike okuteekebwawo ebiseera baliraanwa abeetaaga ddala by'okola.
site.helpers.freeBody: Kuuma 100% ku by'ofuna. SwapSpot teggyako kakomisoni, kitundu kya kikumi, wadde ssente z'okufuna kasitoma.
site.perks.0.1: Wandiika obukugu bwo, ebifaananyi n'ekitundu w'okolera mu ddakiika ntono.
site.perks.2.0: Funa okuteekebwawo ebiseera era oweereze ebbeeyi
site.perks.2.1: Funa okusaba okuva okumpi era oddemu n'ebbeeyi ey'enjawulo.
site.perks.3.1: Funa emmunyeenye ezifuula emirimu egisooka bakasitoma ab'enkalakkalira.
site.categories.title: Omulimu gwonna, waliwo omuyambi
site.categories.body: Ebibinja by'empeereza ez'omu kitundu eby'okutandika, n'ebirala nga akatale ka buli kitundu kakula.
site.trust.title: Kyakolebwa okuwulira obukuumi ku njuyi zombi
site.trust.body: Okwekenneenya okw'amazima, obubaka obwa kyama, n'ebiragiro ebireka baliraanwa nga be bafuga data yaabwe.
site.trustItems.0.1: Emmunyeenye ez'amazima okuva eri baliraanwa ab'amazima oluvannyuma lwa buli mulimu.
site.trustItems.1.1: Kuumira emboozi n'ebbeeyi mu kifo kimu.
site.trustItems.2.1: Loopa oba ziyiza omukozesa yenna buli kiseera.
site.trustItems.3.1: Sangulawo akawunti yo n'ebikwata ku yo buli lw'oyagala.
site.trustItems.4.1: Abayambi be balondawo engeri ekifo kyabwe gye kirabikamu.
site.waitlist.title: Wanula SwapSpot leero
site.waitlist.body: Laba abayambi okumpi ku bwereere. Kozesa ppaasi ng'oli mwetegefu okuweereza obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi oba okuteekawo ekiseera.
site.waitlist.storeCaption: Kati eriwo ku iOS ne Android
site.waitlist.noSpam: Wanula app, laba abayambi, otandike ng'oli mwetegefu.
site.download.title: Wanula SwapSpot eya iOS oba Android
site.download.body: Laba abayambi okumpi ku bwereere. Kozesa ppaasi ng'oli mwetegefu okuweereza obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi oba okuteekawo ekiseera.
site.download.pointB: Okulaba ku bwereere nga tonnatuukirira muyambi
site.footer.tagline: Akatale k'omu kitundu eri obuyambi obwesigika. Kakoleddwa ebitundu mu US yonna.
site.footer.bottom: Funa obuyambi obwesigika obw'omu kitundu okumpi naawe.
site.footer.companyLine: Ekola wansi wa USPROJECT LLC · EIN 83-3989558 · New York, USA
directory.indexMetaDescription: Laba empeereza za SwapSpot ez'olwatu ng'oyita mu kibinja n'akatale k'omu kitundu. Funa okuyonja, okuddaabiriza, okusengula, okuyigiriza, okulabirira ebisolo, okwewunda, empeereza z'ekikugu n'ebirala.
directory.indexTitle: Empeereza z'abayambi ab'omu kitundu ng'ebibinja n'akatale
directory.indexIntro: Empapula zino zikolebwa okuva ku mpeereza z'abayambi ezifulumiziddwa mu SwapSpot. Ziyamba bakasitoma okuzuula ebifaananyi by'empeereza ebituufu nga bayita mu kibuga, koodi ya posita, ekitundu, ekibinja, ebbeeyi, olulimi n'emmunyeenye.
directory.byCountryBody: Buli link wansi eggulawo olupapula olwa lwatu. Omuyambi bw'afulumya ekitundu ky'empeereza ekipya, kirabika wano saayiti bw'emala okuzzibwa obuggya.
directory.emptyBody: Ekitabo kikolebwa okuva ku mpeereza z'abayambi ezifulumiziddwa. Bwe wataba link wano, jja nate mu bbanga ttono oba oggulewo app olabe abayambi okumpi naawe.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Funa abayambi ba {categoryLower} mu {market}. Geraageranya ebifaananyi by'empeereza eby'olwatu, ebitundu by'empeereza, ebbeeyi, ennimi n'emmunyeenye nga tonnaggulawo SwapSpot.
directory.pairOgDescription: Laba empeereza za {categoryLower} ez'omu kitundu okumpi ne {market} weyongerere mu app ya SwapSpot.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: SwapSpot etegeka ebifaananyi by'abayambi ba {categoryLower} mu {market}. Ggulawo app olabe abayambi okumpi, ogeraageranye ebitundu by'empeereza era osabe ebbeeyi.
directory.pairSummary: Geraageranya ebifaananyi by'empeereza za {categoryLower} eby'olwatu okuva ku bayambi ab'omu kitundu okwetoloola {market}. Kozesa app ng'oli mwetegefu okuweereza obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi oba okuteekawo ekiseera.
directory.popularBody: Empeereza zino zijja mu profayiro z'abayambi ezifulumiziddwa, so si lukalala lwa kutunda olutakyukakyuka.
directory.areaTitle: Ekitundu ky'omu kitundu, so si ndagiriro entuufu
directory.areaBody: Empapula ez'olwatu zilaga ebitundu, koodi za posita, ebibuga n'ebanga ly'empeereza bakasitoma basobole okuzuula obuyambi okumpi nga tebalaze ndagiriro za kyama.
directory.namesBody: Empeereza z'abayambi zitereezebwa ne zifuuka emitwe egisobola okunoonyezebwa, ebigambo eby'omu kitundu n'empapula z'ebibinja bakasitoma basobole okunoonya emirimu gye beetaaga ddala.
directory.inAppTitle: Emboozi n'okuteekawo ekiseera bisigala mu app
directory.inAppBody: Website eyamba abantu okuzuula empeereza. SwapSpot ekuuma ebbeeyi, obubaka, ebiseera, okwekenneenya n'ebiragiro by'obukuumi mu app y'essimu.
directory.faqTitle: Olupapula luno olwa lwatu lukola lutya
directory.pairFaq1Q: Nsobola okuteekawo ekiseera n'abayambi ba {categoryLower} mu {market} ku lupapula luno?
directory.pairFaq1A: Olupapula luno lwa kulaba bulaba lwokka okuzuula. Wanula SwapSpot okuweereza abayambi obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi, okugabana endagiriro entuufu n'okuddukanya ebiseera.
directory.pairFaq2A: Nedda. SwapSpot eraga ebitundu by'empeereza ebigerageranyizibwa nga koodi za posita, ebitundu, ebibuga oba ebanga. Endagiriro entuufu zisigala za kyama era zisobola okugabanibwa mu mboozi nga njuyi zombi zeetegefu.
directory.pairFaq3A: Nedda. Abayambi basobola okutonda profayiro n'okuteeka empeereza nga tebasasula kakomisoni wadde ebitundu bya kikumi eri SwapSpot. Bakasitoma be basasula okuyingira nga baagala okuweereza obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi oba okuteekawo ekiseera.
directory.pairListDescription: Ebifaananyi eby'olwatu eby'empeereza za {categoryLower} eziri ku SwapSpot mu {market}.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot eggulawo profayiro z'abayambi ab'omu kitundu okuyita mu butale. Wanula app olabe empeereza okumpi, ogeraageranye ebbeeyi era oweereze abayambi obubaka ng'oli mwetegefu.
directory.cardsBody: Geraageranya empeereza, ebbeeyi, ebitundu, ennimi, emmunyeenye n'obumanyirivu bw'abayambi okumpi ne {market}. Endagiriro entuufu n'okutuukirira butereevu bisigala mu SwapSpot.
directory.cardNoDescription: Laba ekifaananyi ky'empeereza eno mu SwapSpot, oluvannyuma ggulawo app okuweereza obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi oba okuteekawo ekiseera.
directory.helperDescription: {name} awa {services} ng'ayita mu SwapSpot okwetoloola {markets}. Geraageranya ebifaananyi by'empeereza eby'olwatu, ebbeeyi, ennimi, emmunyeenye n'ebitundu by'empeereza nga tonnaggulawo app.
directory.helperDescriptionNoMarket: {name} awa {services} ng'ayita mu SwapSpot. Geraageranya ebifaananyi by'empeereza eby'olwatu, ebbeeyi, ennimi, emmunyeenye n'ebitundu by'empeereza nga tonnaggulawo app.
directory.previewBody: Geraageranya empeereza wano, oluvannyuma weereza obubaka era oteekewo ekiseera mu app.
directory.noCommissionBody: Abayambi bakuuma ensimbi z'emirimu. SwapSpot teggyako kitundu kya kikumi wadde kakomisoni ku mirimu gy'abayambi.
directory.servicesBody: Gano gaba ebifaananyi by'empeereza ebifulumiziddwa okuva mu SwapSpot. Ebbeeyi ziyinza okuba etakyuka, buli ssaawa, okuva ku, oba ng'osabye okusinziira ku mulimu.
directory.serviceFallback: Ggulawo SwapSpot olabe empeereza eno, osabe ebikwata era okakase ebirimu nga tonnateekawo kiseera.
directory.areasBody: Empapula z'abayambi ez'olwatu ziwa ebyuma ebinoonya n'abakasitoma ebimala: amannya g'empeereza, ebitundu, ebibuga, ebitundu ebigerageranyizibwa n'obubonero bw'ennimi. Ebikwata ku kutuukirira ebituufu bisigala mu SwapSpot.
directory.continueTitle: Weereza obubaka, saba ebbeeyi era oteekewo ekiseera ng'olina ebiragiro by'ekyama.
directory.helperFaq1A: Ggulawo SwapSpot okuweereza omuyambi obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi, okugabana ebikwata ku mulimu ebituufu n'okuddukanya ekiseera mu ddembe mu app.
directory.helperFaq2A: Nedda. Empapula ez'olwatu zilaga ebitundu by'empeereza ebigerageranyizibwa nga ebitundu, ebibuga, koodi za posita oba ebanga. Endagiriro entuufu zisigala za kyama okutuusa abakozesa lwe bazigabana mu mboozi.
directory.helperFaq3A: Nedda. Abayambi basobola okuteeka empeereza nga SwapSpot teggyako kakomisoni wadde ekitundu kya kikumi ku nsimbi z'emirimu gyabwe.

directory.categoryBody: Noonyereza empeereza za {categoryLower} okuva ku bayambi ab'omu kitundu kyo.

directory.cityBody: Teekawo ekiseera n'abayambi okumpi mu kuyonja, okuddaabiriza, okukuuma omuddo, okusengula, okulabirira ebisolo, okulabirira abakadde, okuyigiriza n'ebirala. SwapSpot eyamba baliraanwa okugeraageranya empeereza, ebbeeyi, okwekenneenya n'ebiseera by'abayambi nga tebannateekawo kiseera.
directory.cityCategoryBody: Geraageranya abayambi ab'omu kitundu abeesigika okumpi naawe
directory.helpersMetaTitle: Beera Omuyambi - Funa Ensimbi mu Kitundu
directory.helpersMetaDescription: Kyusa obukugu bwo okufuna ensimbi mu kitundu ku SwapSpot. Tonda profayiro y'omuyambi ey'obwereere, teekawo ebbeeyi n'ebiseera by'oliwo, era bakasitoma ab'okumpi bakuteekewo ebiseera.
pricing.title: Laba ku bwereere. Kozesa ppaasi ng'oli mwetegefu okukola.
pricing.body: Bakasitoma basobola okunoonyereza ebibinja n'okugeraageranya abayambi nga tebasasudde. Ppaasi yeetaagisa okuweereza obubaka, okusaba ebbeeyi oba okuteekawo ekiseera n'omuyambi. Okusasula omulimu gwennyini kukkaanyizibwako butereevu n'omuyambi.
pricing.freeBody: Laba ebibinja, ebifaananyi by'abayambi, ebitundu by'empeereza n'obubonero bw'obwesige obw'ennono nga tonnalonda ppaasi.
pricing.plans.0.name: Ppaasi y'olunaku
pricing.plans.0.note: Esinga okukola ku mulimu gumu, obuyambi obwangu, oba okugezaako SwapSpot.
pricing.plans.1.name: Client Pro
pricing.plans.1.note: Esinga okukola ku byetaago bya bulijjo eby'awaka, amaka, okupangisa oba bizinensi.
pricing.plans.1.features.1: Weereza obubaka era osabe ebbeeyi buli kiseera
passPrice.seeStore: Laba ebbeeyi ya kati mu App Store oba Google Play
passPrice.referenceNote: Ebbeeyi ey'okugerageranya. App Store oba Google Play eraga ebbeeyi ey'enkomerero.
passPrice.footnote: Ebbeeyi ey'enkomerero ey'omu kitundu n'emisolo biragibwa App Store oba Google Play nga tonnagula.
staticPages.intro: Olupapula luno luliwo mu lulimi lwe weddizza. Eri ebibuuzo eby'amateeka oba ebikwata ku akawunti, tuukirira hello@swapspot.org.
appPreview.title: Ekiseera kyonna, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero
appPreview.mapBody: Abayambi 12 mu mayilo 2, mu kiseera kino.
appPreview.messageA: Gyebale! Osobola okukola ennyumba y'ebisenge 2 ku Lwamukaaga?
forClients.title: Maliriza omulimu nga tosamba bantu
forClients.body: Ggulawo app, laba ani ali okumpi, geraageranya profayiro ez'amazima, weereza obubaka mu SwapSpot era oteekewo ekiseera nga kiwulira bulungi.
forClients.cards.0.1: Noonya ng'oyita mu kibinja, ebanga, emmunyeenye n'ebiseera by'oliwo.
forClients.cards.1.1: Laba profayiro, ebbeeyi, okwekenneenya, ebifaananyi n'empeereza.
forClients.cards.2.1: Buuza ebibuuzo, kakasa ebikwata era okuume ebbeeyi nga zitegekeddwa.
forClients.cards.3.1: Kozesa okwekenneenya, lipoota, okuziyiza n'ebiragiro bya akawunti nga weetaaga.
cookieConsent.title: Ebyo by'olonda ku kyama
cookieConsent.body: Tukozesa kuukisi za Google Analytics okutegeera abatuukako n'okulongoosa SwapSpot. Osobola okukkiriza oba okugaana kuukisi z'okwekenneenya ezitalina kwetaagisa.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot esindikibwa ku seva empya. Okumala essaawa nga emu, okuyingira, okuzzaawo ekigambo ekyama n'okukyusa akawunti kuyinza obutakola. Gezaako nate oluvannyuma.
reset.title: Zzaawo ekigambo kyo ekyama
reset.intro: Londa ekigambo ekyama ekipya, oluvannyuma yingira mu app ya SwapSpot ne imeeri yo n'ekigambo ekyama ekipya.
reset.done: Ekigambo kyo ekyama kikyusiddwa. Ggulawo app ya SwapSpot oyingire.
reset.invalid: Link eno ey'okuzzaawo teriiwo oba ekomye. Saba empya okuva mu app.
reset.openLink: Ggulawo link y'okuzzaawo okuva mu imeeri yo okweyongerayo.
reset.unavailable: Okuzzaawo ekigambo ekyama tekunnaba kubeera ku saayiti eno.
